task: RK37 data-supported translation-occupancy sequence-model pivot after RK36
scientific_question: Can a fixed local-codon, transcript-centered, mean-anchored ridge improve the two strongest RK05 cross-study controls without using Subtelny14 outcomes for fitting, calibration, alpha selection or model selection?
retrospective_boundary: Subtelny14 outcomes were observed in RK05 and motivated this follow-up. RK37 is a frozen diagnostic follow-up, not an untouched confirmation or a SOTA claim even if both gates pass.

studies.normalization: Official RK05: counts >0.5; record eligible if coverage >0.60 and CDS has no N; density=count/mean(counts[counts>0.5]) at positive positions.
studies.mask: Set first five and last four codons to zero, then retain density >0 positions.
studies.target_access_rule: Target coverage metadata may reproduce the frozen eligibility set. Target normalized outcome vectors, prior target predictions and all target metrics are accessed only after every source fit and alpha/deployment selection is complete.

split.procedure: Exactly RK05 official split: sorted eligible source IDs; np.random.seed(seed); split_seed=randint(0,1024); shuffle with split_seed; first floor(n/10) validation, remainder train.

features.position: RK05 86 columns: ATCG-order 64 codon one-hot, 20 relative-position bins, relative-position scalar, ln(length)/7.
features.local: 477 columns: seven ATCG-order codon one-hots at offsets -3,-2,-1,0,+1,+2,+3 (448), seven in-window validity flags, 20 relative-position bins, relative-position scalar, ln(length)/7. Out-of-window codon one-hots are zero.
features.design: Unscaled float64 sparse CSR; identical rows and masked positions for all compared arms.

targets_and_deployment.raw: Fit official normalized density at source-train masked positions.
targets_and_deployment.centered: For each source-train transcript independently subtract its masked-position mean density; no cross-transcript or target information.
targets_and_deployment.anchor: For each evaluated transcript, prediction_anchor=prediction-mean(prediction at masked positions)+source_train_raw_masked_position_mean. Uses no target outcome and preserves within-transcript Pearson/Spearman.

models.type: sklearn Ridge, fit_intercept=true, solver=lsqr, tol=1e-8, max_iter=10000, float64
models.selection: All alpha selection uses source-validation transcript-balanced MSE only; first grid value breaks ties. position_raw_unanchored uses unanchored validation predictions; every anchored deployment uses anchored validation predictions.

frozen_external_predictions.baseline_fidelity: Record IDs, offsets, positions and float32 target must match exactly; recomputed position_raw_unanchored maximum absolute prediction difference <=1e-6 versus RK05.

primary_endpoints.name: tb_mse_improvement_over_constant
primary_endpoints.required: effect>0, paired bootstrap CI95 lower>0, Holm p<0.05

primary_endpoints.name: mean_pearson_improvement_over_position_raw
primary_endpoints.required: effect>0, paired bootstrap CI95 lower>0, Holm p<0.05; finite pairs only with exclusion count reported

evaluation.sensitivity_gate: Both effects must also be positive for seeds 2345 and 3456; no target-based seed choice.
evaluation.multiplicity: Holm across exactly two primary endpoints
evaluation.secondary: All eight absolute metric sets; position/local x raw/centered diagnostic contrasts; RiboMIMO raw/anchored; global MSE/R2/Pearson and mean/median within-transcript Pearson/Spearman; three seed results.
evaluation.decision_rule: DUAL_DIAGNOSTIC_PASS only if both primary endpoints and sensitivity gate pass. This is not SOTA or independent confirmation. Any failure leaves the cross-study translation task unresolved and triggers diagnosis of the failed component.

execution.cost_claim: Observed CPU wall times only; no unified time-matched claim.
execution.independent_verification: Separate raw parser/features/fitting/metrics/inference without importing production; refit all 48 models and compare predictions within declared numerical tolerance.
execution.clean_reproduction: Fresh checkout of frozen scientific commit, rerun all 48 fits and compare CSV/NPZ artifacts.
